name: batch-06
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A muted teal doorway with a pale stone-colored frame has a dark teal lintel strip bearing the existing small ivory chalk blessing marks, with a short piece of ivory chalk below and a small gold door knob. Preserve the source glyph layout and simple doorway; no extra words or decorations.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: A brown tree trunk and horizontal branch carry a broad muted green canopy, a red hanging paper tag and one small orange-colored fruit tied by a red cord. Preserve the visible looped cord, rectangular tag and round orange weight, without adding writing, coins or extra tags.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: Two soft ivory-white round mochi cakes are stacked with the larger cake below, topped by one orange fruit with a small green leaf, all on a low square tan wooden tray. Keep the two-tier cake silhouette and single orange, without extra paper, cords or inscriptions.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A red-and-ivory twisted cord ring hangs from a brown flowering branch, with two short tassel ends below and two small pale pink blossoms with golden centers on the branch. Preserve the open cord loop, alternating fibers and two tassels, without extra charms or lettering.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: Three small rounded pale beige stones marked respectively 五, 大 and 力 sit beside an open muted teal cloth pouch with a cream lining and a pale gold mouth rim. Keep the three distinct source characters, soft bag opening and three separate stones; no additional writing or charms.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A thin ivory rectangular wafer with a small corner broken away bears one shallow tan geometric four-point star motif and a simple lower border; the separated matching piece sits beside it. Preserve the light crisp wafer and irregular shared break, without added religious imagery or lettering.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A red pomegranate with a small pointed crown is split open to show pale cream pith and ruby-red seeds above a low beige stone threshold, with one loose red seed beside it. Preserve the naturally broken fruit state and visible seeds, without a knife, bowl or decorative additions.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A warm golden-yellow woven ribbon wraps a muted teal metal railing, with three visible tied loops along the hanging portion and two long ribbon tails. Preserve the vertical bars, two crossbars and continuous ribbon path, without adding printed wording or extra charms.
9. Cell row 3, column 3: A thick closed ring of bundled olive-green grass tied with a few pale straw bindings, held upright between two warm-brown wooden posts with short feet. Keep the central opening large and unobstructed.
